seal.statement: ReplicaStateMachine is the sole lifecycle owner for each partition-replica services row, and its handoff to ReplicaRemovalDurableCleanup is linearized on one exact durable generation: every existing-row lifecycle update is an UPDATE guarded by service_id, source status, and the source row's state_entered_at, or updated_at only for an observed legacy row without state_entered_at; an explicit non-apply or zero-row result cannot advance local state; an outcome-unknown REMOVING write fences every non-removal successor until an authoritative point observation proves the intended generation or a same-intent idempotent redrive resolves it; restart and stale or same-state ABA evidence carry their observed generation into the same CAS; canonical partition-leader settlement is confirmed or remains retry debt before services-row deletion or runtime retirement; and only that settled REMOVING generation may terminalize, while repeated completion and already-absent rows are idempotent and never recreate lifecycle authority.

text: Altitude check: the failures are one ReplicaStateMachine-to-ReplicaRemovalDurableCleanup owner interaction, not independent local bugs. The repair is exact durable-generation serialization, authoritative outcome resolution, and settlement-before-deletion.

Owner ruling 2026-09-30 (Track A closure, BINDING): legacy rejoin-hints.json is a ONE-TIME migration source only. Owner file exists and valid -> it is the sole authority; rejoin-hints.json is not read for reservation at all. Owner file absent -> consult legacy hints exactly once for the initial floor: absent hints -> floor 0; valid hints -> migrate from that floor; present but malformed/unreadable -> typed fail-closed refusal, no reservation, no owner write. After the owner file is durably created, legacy hints never gate, raise, lower or otherwise participate in issuance; a later-corrupted hints file cannot take down a valid modern data directory. Hints persistence routes through the owner's durable atomic-write primitive (temp write, file fsync, rename, directory fsync per writeAtomicDurable); eliminate the independent persistence implementation where practical (one owner for durable atomic file replacement). Witnesses: owner absent + corrupt hints -> refusal; owner present + corrupt hints -> reservation succeeds from owner state without inspecting/repairing/rewriting hints; owner present + higher hints counter -> no raise; owner present + lower -> no lower; first migration from valid hints -> owner value strictly after the highest legacy-issued incarnation; after migration deleting/corrupting hints has no effect; red-on-revert restoring unconditional hints reads fails the corrupt-owner-present case. node-id/cluster-id damaged-hints restoration stays a recorded finding (not this round): the authoritative reservation already refuses boot first; separate cleanup only if re-freeze shows an independent authority or reachable fail-open. Track A closed after this unless the witnesses expose another authority leak.
